cap_overrides.title: Cap Overrides
cap_overrides.description: Channels where this agent has their own limit; the rest follow the workspace default.

key.title: Key

email.title: Email

ids.title: Ids
ids.description: Every ticket type id, in the new order.

cap_email.title: Cap Email
cap_email.description: null: follow the workspace default again.

cap_chat.title: Cap Chat
cap_chat.description: null: follow the workspace default again.

cap_messaging.title: Cap Messaging
cap_messaging.description: null: follow the workspace default again.

Sentiment.title: Sentiment
Sentiment.description: Set by triage (keyword rules, Phase 2) or the Cevanos handover.

token.title: Token
token.description: Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Shown only once.

Sort.title: Sort
Sort.description:
Ticket list orders. `priority`: Open and Pending most urgent first, then oldest;
Resolved after them, newest resolved first (T9; SLA time left joins when SLA lands).

counts.description: Per status, ignoring the other filters (for the tabs).

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Send as `cursor`, with the same filters and sort, for the next page. null on the last page.

accepted.title: Accepted
accepted.description: false: a handover waiting for an agent to accept it.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: The latest 50 messages, oldest to newest.

older_messages_cursor.title: Older Messages Cursor
older_messages_cursor.description: Send as `cursor` to GET /tickets/{id}/messages for older messages; null when every message is shown.

TicketPatch.title: TicketPatch
TicketPatch.description: Send only what changes. `null` clears type, team, assignee or one field.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: The whole new list: add, remove, rename or reorder fields.
